subject: HIPAA/BAA eligibility & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Boyd <michael.boyd@medwisehealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-10T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: HIPAA & BAA eligibility — next steps

Hi Michael 

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of eligibility (based on our conversation):
- PHI scope: You indicated the use-cases will include patient identifiers and clinical notes for triage and summarization. That qualifies as PHI.
- BAA requirement: Since PHI will be processed, MedWise will need a signed BAA.
- Eligible Redwood deployment modes for PHI:
  - Hosted API (public shared tenant): NOT eligible for PHI.
  - Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools / VPC-peered): Eligible for PHI with contractual BAA and appropriate network isolation.
  - Redwood Private (customer-managed VPC or on-prem package): Eligible and recommended for highest control (KMS/HSM + audit logs).

Security & compliance highlights we discussed:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (CCPA & availability controls) in 2027; we can share the report under NDA.
- Encryption: Data encrypted at rest and in transit; keys can be customer-managed in private deployments.
- Auditability: Request/response logs retained per configured retention; we can provide per-route telemetry for your audits.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll attach a current Redwood BAA template for your legal team to review.
2) Please confirm which deployment you prefer for PHI workloads (Dedicated vs Private/on-prem). From the call you sounded inclined toward Dedicated.
3) If you'd like, send over MedWise's vendor security questionnaire (or we can provide a link to ours).
4) We'll loop in our Security and Legal teams once you confirm and provide the questionnaire / any redlines.

Deliverables I'll send now: Redwood BAA template + link to our vendor security questionnaire. Let me know if you want me to route the SOC 2 report through an NDA.

Best,
Marissa Cole
